fusions.name: Dead Until It Isn't
fusions.desc: From a feigned stillness you bite, dealing 16 poison damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Misdirected Fangs
fusions.desc: Spits 3 fangs in a spread; each deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 15% chance to turn it against its own side for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Feigned Stillness
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Pocketed the Change
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you restore 6 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
